title: Gaslight Hold
hook: Hold a gaslit street with friends against waves of the risen that never stop.

round.winBy: Hold out as long as you can.

props.name: pump
props.describe: the town pump, the last thing still working

rules.summary: Waves rise from cellars and drains; kills drop coins; after each wave the barrow opens for two minutes and you buy cards that stack into builds.

characters.describe: a night watchman in your colour

build.what: a scoreboard of the best nights across all players
build.how: a module in src/best-nights.js that posts each night's score to the game's backend and draws the board through a panel slot
build.accept: after a run, the board lists the night with the player's name

src.describe: posts and reads the best nights

slots.describe: the frame around the best-nights board

content.notes: No gore: dark scraps and bones.
